newsitem.title: GERMANY: Springer may appeal block to PSG takeover.
newsitem.headline: Springer may appeal block to PSG takeover.

text.p: Publisher Axel Springer Verlag AG said on Monday it was reviewing whether to appeal against a decision by the German cartel office to block its takeover of kiosk chain Postdienst Service Gmbh (PSG).
A spokeswoman for Springer, which publishes the popular Bild newspaper, gave no further details apart from saying the company had a month to make up its mind on whether to appeal.
Earlier, the cartel office said it had barred the takeover of PSG, a unit of the German Post Office, because it would have strengthened Springer's market dominance.
The Berlin-based cartel authority said Springer had a dominant position both nation-wide and in major east German cities through its stable of national and regional newspapers.

A takeover of PSG, which has a chain of kiosks in the east, would harm access for other newspaper publishers to sales outlets and put into question the neutrality of distribution of the print media in Germany, the cartel office said.
